name: Voteban
short: Anonymous slash command voting system to ban users
description: Allows users to anonymously vote to ban other users using slash commands and button-based voting with configurable thresholds and immunity periods. Includes quorum requirements to ensure community participation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores data about votes, immunities, and cooldowns for the purpose of managing ban votes. User IDs and vote timestamps are stored in the bot's config data.
author: YourName
install_msg:
Thanks for installing the Voteban cog! It's now ready to use.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Required Bot Permissions**
  • Ban Members
  • Embed Links
  • View Channel (where votes will be started)
  • Send Messages
  • Use Application Commands

🚀 **GETTING STARTED**
  The cog is now loaded and ready! Simply use the commands below.

📋 **USER COMMANDS**
  • `/voteban <user>` - Start an anonymous ban vote against a user
  • `/votestatus [vote_id]` - Check status of active votes (leave empty for all votes)

🎮 **VOTING BUTTONS**
  • 🔨 **Vote to Ban** - Cast your ban vote anonymously
  • 🛡️ **Vote to Keep** - Cast your keep vote anonymously
  • 📊 **Check Status** - View detailed vote progress (private)

⚙️ **ADMIN-ONLY COMMANDS**
  • `/votebanclear [vote_id]` - Clear a specific vote or all votes
  • `/votebanimmune <user>` - Grant 6-month immunity to a user

📊 **VOTING RULES & MECHANICS**
  ⏱️ **Time Window**: Voting lasts 24 hours from when the vote starts
  👥 **Quorum Requirement**: 1/3 of server members must vote (minimum: 3 votes)
  🔴 **Ban Result**: If >50% vote to ban → User is banned from server
  🛡️ **Immunity Result**: If <50% vote to ban → User gets 6-month immunity
  ⏳ **Cooldown**: Users can start one ban vote every 6 months
  ⚠️ **Quorum Failure**: If participation is too low → Vote fails, no penalties

💡 **USAGE TIPS**
  • All votes are completely anonymous - no one can see how you voted
  • Use the 📊 button to check detailed status privately
  • Quorum requirements prevent small groups from affecting outcomes
  • Users with immunity cannot be targeted for ban votes
  • Vote messages update in real-time showing current counts

❓ **QUICK EXAMPLE**
  1. Use `/voteban @username` to start a vote
  2. The bot sends an embed with voting buttons
  3. Users click 🔨 or 🛡️ to cast their anonymous votes
  4. After 24 hours, the vote automatically finalizes
  5. Results show: banned, immunity granted, or quorum failed
